Symbolic equations of motion

Source: R/physics-mechanics-system.R
SymbolicSystem.Rd

SymbolicSystem() stores equations of motion in one of SymPy's three forms (explicit, implicit with a combined mass matrix, or implicit with separate kinematic and dynamic parts), as SymPy's SymbolicSystem. Attributes such as coordinates, speeds, states, comb_explicit_rhs, comb_implicit_mat and comb_implicit_rhs, and the methods compute_explicit_form(), dynamic_symbols() and constant_symbols(), are reached with $.

Usage

SymbolicSystem(
  coord_states,
  right_hand_side,
  speeds = NULL,
  mass_matrix = NULL,
  coordinate_derivatives = NULL,
  alg_con = NULL,
  output_eqns = list(),
  coord_idxs = NULL,
  speed_idxs = NULL,
  bodies = NULL,
  loads = NULL
)

Arguments

coord_states

Coordinates, or all states when speeds is NULL.

right_hand_side

The right hand side of the equations.

speeds

Generalized speeds.

mass_matrix

Mass matrix of the implicit forms.

coordinate_derivatives

Explicit kinematic equations.

alg_con

Indices of algebraic constraint equations.

output_eqns

A named list of output equations.

coord_idxs, speed_idxs

Zero based indices of the coordinates and speeds in coord_states.

bodies, loads

Bodies and loads of the system.

Value

A SymbolicSystem object.

Examples

x <- dynamicsymbols("x"); v <- dynamicsymbols("v")
s <- SymbolicSystem(list(x, v), Matrix(list(v, -x)))
s$states
#> Matrix(2, 1)
#> [x(t)]
#> [v(t)]
s$comb_explicit_rhs
#> Matrix(2, 1)
#> [v(t) ]
#> [-x(t)]
